title: Refund & Wallet Credit Policy
content: Refund types: UPI/Card payments: Refund to source (3-5 working days). Infosys Credit Wallet: Instant credit. Refund wallet can be used for next campaign. Refund timeline summary: Wallet (instant), UPI (24-48 hrs), Credit/Debit Card (3-5 days), NetBanking (3-5 days). If refund not received after 7 days: Contact us with invoice ID and transaction reference number. We'll trace with payment gateway. Wallet expiry: 12 months from last activity. Promo credit may have shorter validity (check T&C). Refund to bank: Only possible if original payment was from bank. Minimum refund amount: Rs 100. Amounts below Rs 100 are credited as credit wallet balance.
